notes.title: Full Version Preview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45624806/691597bf8f9bcb0ef4d4bec440583de51cac6c76.png[/img]
The Student Handbook will be a quick cheat sheet that reminds you of all the perks and what they do. Ultimately, it will even include what powers you will gain when you specialize in certain Subjects (achieved by having the Subject as your most matched pair)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45624806/0592c9e59f1f7b580a67cd81a842eafef19bbd03.png[/img]
The Skill Tree will (likely) replace the end game shop and allow returning students to stay more prepared for future academia. Instead of buying a perk and gain a new ability, students can now slowly but surely improve themselves, one card flip at a time.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45624806/c094bf4057947347ed44990fcfcca4d32721d6df.png[/img]
Let's face it. School is stressful and panic will happen to even the smartest out there. We will prepare more sanity behaviors and jumpscares for a more immersive gameplay.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45624806/1560c89674000b09c92c9193522954916ad7aad9.png[/img]
In addition to Perks, your major (the subject you have the most pairs made) will give you special powers. Each subject will have a different power, challenging your ability to adapt and make good use of it. From now on, every single round plays differently!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45624806/28a32c322a422930af1a766262a7436c3248a007.png[/img]
Want to test your skills with some stress disaster? Or do you want to try out the wombo-combo you dream of? Hoop onto a custom run and make your dream / nightmare come true!

There are many more updates in the full version. Stay tuned and remember to wishlist us for more updates!
